newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: Sri Lanka stocks close up, powered by blue chips.
newsitem.headline: Sri Lanka stocks close up, powered by blue chips.

text.p: Sri Lanka stocks closed up on Friday for the fifth successive session, mainly on gains by blue chips, brokers said.

The all share index closed 2.1 points up at 841.3, despite price declines outnumbering gains by 33 to 29. Blue chips Aitken Spence rose 10.25 rupees to 220, John Keells Holdings 4.75 to 370, Central Finance 25 to 375, Richard Pieris four to 124.
The index has risen 23.8 points since July 17, when it closed at 817.5 points.
"The index should move up further since the market is very firm" said Deva Ellepola of brokerage Jardine Fleming HNB.
"There is more buying than profit-taking, which is happening in some low value shares Like Sampath and Grain Elevators, where interim results to June have been good," he added.
Turnover was 60.6 million rupees, supported by 54,700 shares of Development Finance and 70,000 Sampath Bank.
Foreign buying and selling was worth 24.6 million rupees and 22.5 million, respectively.
